talking_points: The US FTC has issued subpooena-style demands to OpenAI and Anthropic over AI safety incidents, putting consumer-harm enforcement on the table.
Anthropic has handed the nonprofit METR employee-level access to its systems, a notable step toward independent AI oversight.
Fintech dealmaking keeps rolling, with Intuit buying revenue-management startup Sequence and Cohere lining up a cybersecurity acquisition.
